title: Google Maps contractor website collection
description: Search Google Maps by construction trade and location, collect public company websites and profile data, and skip duplicates across runs.

startUrls.title: Optional Google Maps search URLs
startUrls.description: Paste Maps search URLs here, or leave empty and use search terms plus locations.

searchTerms.title: Construction trades
searchTerms.description: Each trade is searched in every target location.

locations.title: Target locations
locations.description: Use city and state together, for example Los Angeles, California.

maximumNewCompanies.title: Maximum new companies this run
maximumNewCompanies.description: Stops after this many unique companies with valid websites are saved.

maximumProfilesVisited.title: Maximum Maps profiles visited
maximumProfilesVisited.description: Profiles without websites still count as visited. Use about twice the desired website count.

maximumResultsPerSearch.title: Maximum profiles discovered per search
maximumResultsPerSearch.description: Maximum Google Maps listings queued from each trade and location search.

requireWebsite.title: Require company website
requireWebsite.description: Output only companies with a valid external website.

collectEmailsFromCompanyWebsites.title: Visit company websites for public email
collectEmailsFromCompanyWebsites.description: Visit the external website and contact page to find a publicly displayed email. This increases run time and cost.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use Apify residential proxy
useResidentialProxy.description: Recommended when Google blocks or limits the Actor.

proxyCountryCode.title: Proxy country code
proxyCountryCode.description: Two-letter country code for the residential proxy.

campaignName.title: Campaign name
campaignName.description: Keep unchanged to continue progress and skip companies already processed.

resetProgress.title: Reset saved progress
resetProgress.description: Erase this campaign's queue and duplicate history before running.

pageTimeoutSecs.title: Page navigation timeout
pageTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds allowed for one page navigation.

delayMillis.title: Delay between profile pages
delayMillis.description: Polite delay between Google Maps profile visits.
